title: Ever platform catalog
description: The index Ever Works reads to render the Ever apps in its App Launcher. Addresses are data in this repository; none appear in platform code.

platforms.description: At most 24 entries; ids are unique across the array.

id.description: Also the key the App Launcher stores a per-person preference under, as `platform:<id>`.

urls.description: One address per environment. The environment Ever Works reads is chosen by EVER_WORKS_PLATFORM_CATALOG_ENV (default `production`) at read time; all three are required so a missing environment is a visible error rather than a silent absence.

address.description: An absolute https address. `TBD` is accepted ONLY as the explicit marker for an owner-supplied address that has not been provided yet: the validator reports it as a warning, never as an error, and anything else that is not an https address is an error.
